messages:
Raj Patel: Heads-up — Neon Labs wants us to onboard an open model for their chat product: 'neon-open-2.1'. They need hosted availability in EU + APAC, ability to pin to a specific model SHA, and an option for Dedicated if latency SLOs require it. Asking for rough timeline & pricing. They mentioned 99p latency target ~300ms for short prompts.

Alice Gomez: @Raj thanks. Can you paste the model manifest + license and confirm whether this is generation (streaming) only or also embeddings/reranking? Also do they require version pin across regions?

Raj Patel: Quick copy from their note:
```
model: neon-open-2.1
arch: causal
params: 13B
license: apache-2.0
quant_support: int8,fp16
features: streaming generation
pinning: require pin to sha: a1b2c3d4
regions: eu-west, apac-sin
contact: emma@neonlabs.com
```
They explicitly asked for pin-to-sha and cross-region availability.

Mei Chen: FYI Emma already filed a support ticket — ticket# 2026-NEON-44. Attached sample logs show 64-token runs are fine, but they see spikes when requests include ~2k tokens. Also asked about automatic failover between EU and APAC.

Tomas Novak: Note on infra: eu-west has spare capacity for 13B fp16. apac-sin is tight for 13B with an int8 runtime; our int8 execution path for models with fused attention/rotary is still experimental for production. If they want Dedicated we can reserve GPUs but hosted pin across both regions requires capacity check and possibly kernel adjustments.

Kelsey Nguyen: Technical quick-take: neon-open-2.1 uses rotary embeddings + fused attention; our fp16 kernel works, int8 path needs validation. We should run a regression eval after quantize-to-int8 to check quality drop. Suggested eval checklist: correctness (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable), toxic content scans, latency P95/P99, and token-efficiency. I can queue eval once we have a 5–10k token sample deck.

Alice Gomez: Proposed plan: 1) Intake -> create product backlog item (P2 customer-driven) 2) Create eval ticket (prod-eval/NEON-2.1) assigned to Kelsey 3) Infra capacity/compat check (assigned to Tomas) 4) Legal/licensing + pinning confirmation 5) Rollout: canary on eu-west (hosted), then expand to apac-sin; if APAC latency can't meet SLO we offer Dedicated reserve and negotiation. Agree?

Raj Patel: @Alice yes — customer is fine with a canary. They'll provide dataset and explicit permission for us to run evals. They are open to Dedicated if needed; pricing negotiation possible after we verify SLOs. :thumbsup:

Tomas Novak: Action: I'll run gpu capacity check and kernel compatibility test for apac-sin by EOD tomorrow. If the int8 path fails we can either 1) run fp16 in APAC (costly) or 2) recommend Dedicated for APAC region. Assigning to myself. :eyes:

Kelsey Nguyen: I'll wait for Raj to upload the sample prompts/dataset and then run the regression suite. ETA ~3 business days after data in intake ticket. Assigning to Kelsey.

intake-bot: created intake ticket INT-2026-881, linked support ticket 2026-NEON-44, created sub-tasks: PROD-NEON-EVAL, INFRA-NEON-CAP, LEGAL-NEON-PIN, assigned to Alice, Kelsey, Tomas.

Alice Gomez: Great. I'll add this thread to the backlog under catalog/onboarding with label customer-request/neon and priority P2. Next steps: Raj to share dataset + contact permission; Tomas to post capacity findings; Kelsey to post eval summary and pass/fail thresholds. We'll reconvene after Kelsey posts eval results. Thanks everyone!
